item.title: Daily digest — 2026-07-27
item.description:
Our community has seen significant progress across multiple projects recently. The `statcheck` and `escicheck` projects have focused on administrative updates and synchronizing changes, with `escicheck` incorporating updates from the `escicheckapp` repository. Meanwhile, `oddpub` has enhanced its ontogenerator's code validation, and `docpluck` has addressed documentation and testing issues, including fixes for specific modules and rendering problems. The `coarse` project has re-enabled Fable 5 in the model picker, and `regcheck` has resolved several bugs, including issues with the demo page, card preview, and ad blocker interference. These updates demonstrate the community's commitment to improving and refining our open-source research tools, and we celebrate the connections and collaborations that make this progress possible.

item.title: metacheck: 1 commit today
item.description:
scienceverse/metacheck

The `data_check` branch was worked on, where a RO-crate metadata file was added, replacing the existing collection.json file. The full preview from the archive was removed as part of this change. Additionally, regex bugs were fixed, as stated in the commit message, which aimed to resolve specific issues with regular expressions. The changes were made by Lakens, who implemented these modifications on July 26, 2026. The removal of the full preview and the addition of the RO-crate metadata file suggest a shift in how data is handled and presented in the repository.
